stem.en: Article 243(d) of the Constitution provides not less than one-third reservation for women out of the seats filled by direct election in every Panchayat. A Panchayat has 25 directly elected seats. What is the smallest number of these seats that can be reserved for women?

explanation.en: One-third of 25 is 25 ÷ 3, which is about 8.33. Reserving 8 seats would be less than one-third, and a seat cannot be divided, so the smallest allowed number is 9.

hints.en: Work out one-third of 25. Is the answer a whole number? Remember that the rule says "not less than".
